issue_context.title: QuantBook unit tests are excluded and failing
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Unit tests should be passing.

#### Actual Behavior
The `QuantBook` unit tests are currently excluded from Travis build and are failing locally.

#### Potential Solution
Add the `Jupyter/RegressionScripts` folder in `PythonSetup.Setup` and add this line in the `QuantBook` constructor:
``` C#
 SubscriptionManager.SetDataManager(new DataManager());
```

#### Reproducing the Problem
Run unit tests locally.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
- [x] I have provided detailed steps to reproduce the issue

review_comments: The horrors of statics! not for now, but a later refactoring would be to remove these statics and the symbol properties statics and convert them into provides (similar to map/factor file) -- benefit would be could define a `GitHubMarketHoursDatabaseProvider` which fetches the file from github (same with symbol properties)!
not for now, but next time, I think there may be a way to do a global test clean up function, after each test we should be resetting all static state so the test starts clean
